serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #bot.Expression.Blush #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Lady Annalie: Take a look around. You: It’s so busy. Lady Annalie: See? No one is even looking this way. Everyone is busy with their models, there’s no time to peek at the other teams. Bot: Y-You are right, but it is still a shock to me… You: You will be fine. …As long as no one realizes that you are a bot, that is. But Annalie is right. No one is paying us any attention. They are all professionals. We really stick out like a sore thumb here. Where are Annalie’s friends though?! I hate to be the one to ask and ruin the mood, but this is no joke here! #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm You: Annalie, I don't mean to sound like a dick, but where is the other model? #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Pervy+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm Lady Annalie: Unfortunately, you are right. This is getting ridiculous. I need to call them. Lady Annalie: beep boop boop #Annalie_Outside.face.smileEyeClosed Lady Annalie: Oh, hi~ It’s me… #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.VeryShock Lady Annalie: {{punch}}WHERE THE HELL ARE YOU?! DO YOU THINK IT’S A JOKE?! Lady Annalie: Aha. {{wi}}Ok. {{wi}} {{punch}}Bitch! You promised me this! {{wi}}Why should I care about some fucking parasite in your gut, get your ass down here! {{wi}}I can’t believe you’ve done this to me. {{wi}}Bye. #Annalie_Outside.face.sad #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.sad Lady Annalie: That bitch. She said she got sick too. Some Thai fish or some shit, who fucking cares about that! #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Normal+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm Lady Annalie: We are completely fucked… {{wi}}You were right, I should’ve found another model, or at least a backup… {{wi}} It’s over… You: Don’t say that, we can’t give up now! #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.angry Bot: He’s right! You worked too hard for this! You: Maybe we could go and ask someone to lend us a model? Lady Annalie: That’s not gonna happen. Even if it isn’t an official competition, people here are merciless. Bot: There’s still time! While you adjust my outfit, Anon can go and look for another model! Lady Annalie: How the hell is he going to find a model on such short notice? Bot: He will do it! You: I-I will? Bot: He will! You can believe in him, Annalie! You: She can?! #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Lady Annalie: Well, if you say it so passionately all I can do is to put my trust in you. Please don’t… Bot: Annalie’s dream depends on your success! You cannot fail! You: P-Please, give me a break… Bot: What are you waiting for?! Go! You: O-Ok…
